raymarching_integration.insertion_point: Inside iteration loop or post-DE calculation
raymarching_integration.condition: When orbit trap is enabled and fake lights active
raymarching_integration.distance_calculation: Based on distance to orbit trap shape center
raymarching_integration.performance_impact: O(iterations) per pixel, can be GPU intensive

processing_stages: 1. Orbit trap calculation in iteration loop
material_pipeline.output: Final pixel color with fake lights contribution

optimization_opportunities: Early exit when trap distance > threshold

gpu_vs_cpu.recommended: GPU (OpenCL) for production, CPU for development

orbit_trap_calculation.timing: Calculated every iteration, accumulated over all iterations
orbit_trap_calculation.color_contribution: Based on minimum trap distance across iterations

fake_lights_integration.hybrid_mode: Orbit trap color blended with aux.color and radius/DE
fake_lights_integration.boolean_mode: Each boolean component can have separate trap settings

volumetric_effects.iteration_fog: Fog density based on iteration count

optimization_hints.early_exit: Skip trap calc if distance already large
optimization_hints.vectorization: Use float4 for parallel trap calculations
optimization_hints.shared_params: Pass trap center/size as kernel constants
optimization_hints.texture_lookup: Use 3D texture for complex trap shapes

common_issues.performance: High iteration counts make trap calc expensive
common_issues.color_bleeding: Trap color can dominate surface color
common_issues.opencl_sync: Trap params must match between CPU and GPU

algorithm_flow: 1. Initialize orbit trap distance to large value
b. Compute distance to trap shape
b. Blend with surface color based on weight
4. Apply final shading with light sources

data_structures.sFractalOut: Contains aux.color, orbit trap distance, DE
data_structures.sOrbitTrap: Trap center, size, shape type, color

extension_points: Add new trap shapes by implementing distance function
Custom trap coloring using gradient textures
Animated traps by varying center over time
